name: The Tortured Soul

angles.text: Channeling tormented souls and preparing dark rites at ancient offering stones reflect the grim, manipulative nature of demonic and shadow magic.
Silverpine Forest is Forsaken territory, where dark magic and lingering suffering threaten the borders of Lordaeron.
The rite draws foul energy from suffering spirits, in stark opposition to the restorative principles of the Holy Light.

aliases: what is the tortured soul quest
faq.answer: The Tortured Soul tells of an unfinished dark rite at Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest. An offering stone awaits blood and the soul of a tormented creature.
The ritual altar and its offering stone are at Beren's Peril, a perilous mountainous enclave in Silverpine Forest.
faq.q: Where does this ritual take place?

faq.answer: A scrap of note at the altar says that nearly all the materials are gathered. The two still needed are blood and a Tortured Soul.
faq.q: What components are required for the ritual?

faq.answer: Nearby creatures dwelling among Beren's Peril's crags are tortured enough to yield the essence the offering stone needs.
faq.q: Where do you find the Tortured Soul?

aliases: what happens when you bring soul
faq.answer: Bringing the tortured soul to the offering stone releases foul energy and brings the dark rite closer to completion.
faq.q: What happens when the Tortured Soul is brought to the altar?

faq.answer: No creator is named. The note and hurriedly gathered materials suggest someone assembled the altar in haste among Beren's Peril's hostile denizens.
faq.q: Who created the ritual at Beren's Peril?

sections.body: At Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest, an altar bears the remains of a hastily assembled dark rite. A scrawled note lies among the scattered materials. Most of the ingredients are already gathered, but the rite still calls for blood and a Tortured Soul.
sections.title: A Hasty Rite

sections.body: The creatures dwelling among Beren's Peril's crags endure great agony, making them fit sources for the rite's needed essence. Bring that soul to the ominous offering stone, and foul magical energy surges from it. The rite moves closer to fulfillment.
sections.title: Foul Energies Unleashed

summary: At Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest, a dark rite waits unfinished. An abandoned note names the last offerings still needed: blood and a soul marked by suffering.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tortured Soul
